post.description: Adds a history row without updating the Followup's current snapshot. To record that EA performed another follow-up, call POST /api/ea/followups/{id}/record-followup instead (it writes this same history row plus the snapshot). Never call both for one event.

post.summary: Record a follow-up (canonical action: snapshot + one history row)
post.description: Use this when EA performed another follow-up. Updates the Followup's current snapshot and appends exactly one ea_followup_cycles history row (employeeId/employeeName = operator). Do not also call POST /cycles for the same event.

intakeRequestId.description: Optional reference. Omit or send null when unused. If supplied, use an existing positive ID; zero and negative IDs are invalid.

workflowInstanceId.description: Optional reference. Omit or send null when unused. If supplied, use an existing positive ID; zero and negative IDs are invalid.

subject.description: Required nonblank subject, trimmed before storage; maximum 500 characters.

priorityLevelId.description: Optional reference. Omit or send null when unused. If supplied, use an existing positive ID; zero and negative IDs are invalid.

reminderRecipientUserId.description: Optional reference. Omit or send null when unused. If supplied, use an existing positive ID; zero and negative IDs are invalid.

sequenceNumber.description: Optional parent sequence number, not a follow-up cycle number. Omit or send null; no number needs to be manufactured. If supplied, must be greater than zero.

businessModuleId.description: Optional reference. Omit or send null when unused. If supplied, use an existing positive ID; zero and negative IDs are invalid.

CreateFollowupRequestDto.description: Create a standalone follow-up with all source fields null, or optionally link an existing intake, workflow, or business-module/record pair. Subject and DueAt are required. Timestamps use UTC; next follow-up may precede the due date. Id and audit/completion fields are server-controlled and must not be supplied.

statusId.description: Optional reference. Omit or send null when unused. If supplied, use an existing positive ID; zero and negative IDs are invalid.

intakeRequestId.description: Optional reference. Omit or send null when unused. If supplied, use an existing positive ID; zero and negative IDs are invalid.
